children: Gossamer Bio submitted a New Drug Application to the FDA for seralutinib for pulmonary arterial hypertension, its first NDA filing.
NDA filed in Sept 2026 for seralutinib to treat PAH, marking the company's first NDA submission.
Submission is supported by Phase 3 PROSERA as the adequate and well-controlled study plus Phase 2 TORREY confirmatory evidence.
FDA minutes from a June 2026 Pre-NDA meeting framed PROSERA statistical issues as review, not filing, matters and gave submission format guidance.
FDA will decide whether to accept the NDA for filing after initial review; company anticipates that decision could occur later this year.

title: Gossamer Bio submits first NDA for seralutinib in pulmonary arterial hypertension
